item.title: Police receive slightly fewer burglary reports in 2025
item.description: The number of reported burglaries in Denmark in 2025 was almost the same as the year before, according to new figures from Statistics Denmark. A total of 30,825 burglaries were reported to the police, compared with 30,919 in 2024. Burglaries in unoccupied buildings and at businesses fell last year, while reports of break-ins at private […]

item.title: Four out of 10 young homeowners in Copenhagen have wealthy parents
item.description: More than four out of 10 young homeowners in Copenhagen have parents with wealth in the top 10 percent, according to a new analysis from the Arbejderbevægelsens Erhvervsråd, a Danish economic think tank. The study shows that children of wealthy parents are increasingly present in the housing markets of major cities. The trend is most […]

item.title: Iranian-flagged container ship detained in Denmark
item.description: A container ship anchored east of Ålbæk in Northern Jutland is being detained by Danish authorities. The Danish Maritime Authority confirmed that the vessel, named “Nora,” is held because it is not correctly registered. The ship recently changed its name from “Cerus” and now flies an Iranian flag after previously sailing under a Comorian flag. […]

item.title: The voices of the detainees and associations that will participate in Saturday’s demonstration against Denmark’s asylum policy
item.description: A coalition of residents, activists, and rights groups will hold a demonstration in Copenhagen demanding the closure of Denmark’s deportation centres, highlighting harsh living conditions, and restricted freedoms. These are the voice of some of the people who live in the centers, as well as the promoting organization.

item.description: Danes can expect warmer weather this weekend after weeks of sub-freezing temperatures, following the coldest January in 16 years. item.title: Menopause hormone therapy does not increase cancer risk
item.description: Women treated with hormones during menopause do not face a higher risk of dying from cancer or cardiovascular diseases than non-users. This is the conclusion of a major study published in the British Medical Journal, involving nearly 900,000 Danish women. item.title: Venstre to merge courts to reduce wait times
item.description: To reduce waiting times in the justice system, the Venstre party proposes centralizing probate and enforcement court work from 24 district courts into a single unit. item.description: Several Danish insurance companies are warning homeowners that upcoming thaw weather could cause significant water damage. item.description: Denmark added 25% VAT to gym memberships and personal training and it’s already changing the fitness landscape. Derek and Annie talk about it with personal trainer and educator Mikkel Valgreen
